title: Hello World — Welcome to My Blog
content:
Welcome to my personal corner of the internet. This is where I'll be sharing my thoughts on technology, development, and everything in between.

Why a Blog?

In a world of social media hot takes and algorithmic feeds, having your own space to write long-form content feels more important than ever. A personal blog gives you ownership over your words, your ideas, and how they're presented.

What to Expect

I plan to write about:

  • Web development and modern frameworks
  • Software engineering practices and patterns
  • Interesting projects I'm working on
  • Lessons learned from building things

Stay tuned for more posts. If you'd like to connect, find me on any of the social links below.
